'''Rumil''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], personal [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were banned on Rumil. The [[Exchange]] sensed an opportunity, and wished to hire someone to deliver [[Black market/Legends|black market]] weapons to Rumil.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|A New Market}}</ref>
